decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm’s established practice software in a growing market, and with no visible sign of underperformance after launch, management would likely keep it because its results are at least plausibly satisfactory and the firm has enough experience and slack to continue testing demand.

Because this support service directly builds on the firm’s strong customer-service capabilities and core dental-practice offer, behavioral-theory logic suggests management would keep it absent clear shortfalls, especially in a mature firm with broad offerings and ongoing R&D.
